question: In India, the Industrial Policy Resolution was passed in the year _______ for the first time.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1948.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Industrial Policy Resolution of 1948** was the first comprehensive policy statement of the Government of India regarding the **industrial development** of the country.
 
• The resolution aimed to lay the foundation of a **socialistic pattern of society** by promoting the **growth of industries **in the **public sector **and regulating the private sector.
 
• The resolution also emphasized the need for the state to take an active role in the development of infrastructure, such as** power, transport, and communication,** which are essential for the growth of industries.
 
• The resolution was later replaced by the **Industrial Policy of 1956**, which further strengthened the role of the public sector in industrial development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1949** was the year when the **Planning Commission** was established in India, which played a significant role in the **economic planning** of the country.
 
• **1946** was the year when the **Interim Government of India** was formed, which was responsible for the administration of the country until the transfer of power to the** Indian government in 1947.**
 
• **1947 **was the year when India gained **independence from British rule**, which marked a significant turning point in the history of the country.
 
 
• The year also saw the **partition of India and the creation of Pakistan**.
